subject.title: refactor(media): consolidate parallel media-kind unions onto canonical MediaKind

question: Should the existing public `MediaKind` contract gain `sticker` and `unknown`, or should the broader canonical media-fact union use a new type while preserving the current SDK type?
rationale: This is an SDK compatibility direction choice: an additive literal union is source-breaking for external exhaustive TypeScript consumers, and a review cannot safely choose the permanent public contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve the public contract
options.body: Introduce a new canonical fact/inbound-media union for `sticker` and `unknown`, while retaining the existing four-value `MediaKind` export for MIME-routing consumers.

options.title: Accept the SDK expansion
options.body: Broaden `MediaKind` deliberately, document the upgrade impact, and provide a compatibility notice and focused external-consumer coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve the public contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a new canonical fact/inbound-media union for `sticker` and `unknown`, while retaining the existing four-value `MediaKind` export for MIME-routing consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged media-placeholder work and this follow-up both connect this contributor to the contract being consolidated.
